subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint: commitment tracker & sprintboard
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kelley <sarah.kelley@stellarretail.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2026-03-12T08:14:00Z
Subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint: commitment tracker & sprintboard

Hi Sarah / team —

Thanks again for taking time this morning. Per our MAP cadence, attaching the latest commitment tracker and a one-page sprintboard for the evaluation week. I captured the high-level timeline we agreed on and three open decisions we need to close this week.

Quick highlights:
- Demo environment handed to Stellar on 3/10; performance baseline collection completed.
- Procurement requested updated SOW and a single-line pricing summary for committed capacity.
- Two evaluation test-cases failed intermittently (query 7 and chatflow #3) — Rafael is investigating root cause.

Attachments: MAP-v2-commitment-board.xlsx (tab: Owners & DueDates), evaluation-test-plan.pdf

Planned agenda for Friday 3/13 MAP sync (30 min):
1) Decisions: pricing commitment level, SLA exceptions
2) Blockers: intermittent failures and mitigation plan
3) Owners & dates: finalize canary schedule and procurement milestone

Action requested before Friday:
- Sarah: confirm preferred procurement contact (name + email) so we can route the SOW.
- Rafael: short blameless note on root cause hypothesis for query 7 by EOD today.
- Marissa: prepare a single-slide pricing summary (commit vs burst) by tomorrow morning.

Thanks — I’ll circulate notes after Friday’s sync.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0102

From: Sarah Kelley <sarah.kelley@stellarretail.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: procure@hubops.io
Date: 2026-03-12T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint: commitment tracker & sprintboard

Vanessa —

Thanks for the notes and the attachments. Quick answers:
- Procurement contact is Lydia Morales (lydia.morales@stellarretail.com). She owns vendor onboarding and SOW reviews.
- We reviewed the evaluation failures internally; I'll bring logs for chatflow #3 to the sync.

Decision note: Stellar is leaning toward a 6-month committed pool with a 20% burst buffer if the cost delta is <12% vs on-demand. We'll confirm after Marissa's slide.

See you Friday.

Best,
Sarah
Sr. Product Manager, ML Integrations
Stellar Retail
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-03-12T13:22:00Z
Subject: RE: Weekly MAP checkpoint: commitment tracker & sprintboard

Short update / notes from engineering investigation (root-cause hypothesis):

- Query 7 intermittent failures appear tied to KV-cache warmup on longer prefix sequences — repro rate ~ 18% under the current demo traffic pattern.
- Chatflow #3 issue is related to a timeout threshold (2500ms) being hit when external intent API responds slowly in the demo environment.

Planned remediation steps (owners + rough dates):
- Rafael: implement KV-cache pre-warm on demo environment + automated smoke tests (target: 3/14).
- Stephanie: raise timeout threshold to 3500ms for the demo only and coordinate with Infra (target: 3/13).
- Jonas: run a 4-hour soak test after fixes and report latency distribution (target: 3/15).

I attached a short test-plan (evaluation-test-plan.pdf). Will update the MAP spreadsheet tabs with these owners + due dates.

Rafael
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Sarah Kelley <sarah.kelley@stellarretail.com>
Cc: rafael_mendes@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-03-12T16:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint: commitment tracker & sprintboard

Quick follow-ups after today's internal prep:

Decisions made (to document in MAP):
- Pricing posture: submit 6-month committed proposal with a 12% maximum premium for the burst buffer. Owner: Marissa (due 2026-03-13 10:00 PST).
- Procurement handoff: SOW + pricing summary to Lydia Morales (Owner: Vanessa; Done: 2026-03-12 15:30 PST — sent DocuSign link).
- Evaluation gating: two intermittent failures must be reduced to <5% repro rate before production rollout (Owner: Rafael; target 2026-03-15).

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Vanessa: Confirm Lydia received DocuSign packet and add Procure contact to HubSpot (due 2026-03-12 18:00 PST).
- Marissa: Finalize single-slide pricing summary and share in Drive (file: pricing-onepager-v2.pptx) (due 2026-03-13 10:00 PST).
- Rafael: Deploy cache pre-warm and post smoke-test report (due 2026-03-14 18:00 PST).
- Stephanie: Adjust demo timeout and confirm Infra approval (due 2026-03-13 12:00 PST).
- Jonas: Run soak test and upload results to MAP board (due 2026-03-15 12:00 PST).

Agenda for next sync (2026-03-13 09:00 PT):
- Confirm procurement contact and DocuSign status
- Review Marissa's pricing slide and lock commitment level
- Validate remediation progress (Rafael/Stephanie/Jonas)
- Agree on rollout window and post-eval checkpoint

Please hit reply to confirm owners or flag if dates need to move.

Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
